rules: Never omit or replace source-derived content.
Preserve Hindi/Devanagari source text as extracted, with page number.
Do not invent textbook questions, answers, facts, names, dates or activities and label generated material GENERATED.
For poems, preserve line structure as far as PDF extraction permits; original PDF remains authoritative for typography.
For plays/dialogues, preserve पात्र परिचय, दृश्य, संवाद and stage directions in source-derived files.
Visuals/illustrations/maps/diagrams are retained in original PDFs and referenced by page; never fabricate missing visual information.
Every chapter must contain all six pillars and an internal traceability index.
